reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 沙水游戏桌的工具分工

materials.title: Sand Water Table 011
materials.text: There are two play tables. The sand table has red tools. The water table has blue tools. Keep the tools at their own tables. Use the small cup to fill the boat. Stop before water reaches the black line. Wipe the floor if water spills. Ask the teacher for a dry cloth.

questions.prompt: A friend carries a red spade to the water table. You say, "____"
options: Keep red tools at the sand table.
All tools go in the water.
Put the spade in your lunch box.
questions.explanation: A红工具留沙桌；B全部入水违分工；C饭盒非工具存处。

questions.prompt: A friend asks which tools are for water play. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B水桌蓝工具；A红工具沙桌；C厨房工具未分配。

questions.prompt: A friend tries to fill the boat with a large bucket. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C小杯灌船；A布不能按指定方式灌；B红铲属沙桌。

questions.prompt: Water is almost at the black line. Your friend wants to add more. You say, "____"
options: Make the line wet with paint.
questions.explanation: A黑线前停；B越线相反；C颜料改线无关。

questions.prompt: A friend spills water on the floor. You say, "____"
options: Leave it and run through it.
Ask for a dry cloth and wipe it.
questions.explanation: B求干布擦地；A不擦且跑违处理；C外套不是指定清洁工具。

materials.title: Library Reading Mats 011
materials.text: At story time, take one mat each. Sit in a circle with your feet on your mat. The two front mats are for children who cannot see the small pictures well. Choose books after the story, not during it. Put mats back in the basket before you choose a book.

questions.prompt: A friend takes two mats for one child. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A每人一垫；B整篮、C再占前垫均超所需分配。

questions.prompt: A friend’s feet are on another child’s mat. You say, "____"
options: Put your feet on the books.
Keep your feet on your own mat.
Stand on the other child’s mat.
questions.explanation: B脚留自己垫；A书上非位置；C仍占他人垫。

questions.prompt: A child cannot see the small pictures from the back. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C前两垫给看不清者；A回家、B躲后面不改善看图。

questions.prompt: A friend gets up to choose a book during the story. You say, "____"
options: Wait until the story is over.
questions.explanation: A故事结束才选；B立即全选、C打断均非规则。

questions.prompt: The story is over, and a friend wants a book. You say, "____"
options: Leave the mat on the floor.
Put the mat in the basket first.
questions.explanation: B选书前收垫；A遗留、C带回家均不符合收尾。

materials.title: Puddle Sky Reflection 011
materials.text: After the rain, I walk home with Grandpa. There is a puddle on the path. I see a cloud in it. I say, "A cloud is on the ground!" Grandpa smiles and asks me to look up. The same cloud is in the sky. A leaf falls into the puddle and makes little circles. The cloud picture moves. We walk around the water and keep our shoes dry.

questions.prompt: The writer walks with Grandpa after rain.
questions.explanation: A正确：After rain walk with Grandpa；B否认时间和同伴。

questions.prompt: The cloud in the sky has fallen to the ground.
questions.explanation: B正确：抬头同云仍在天上，水中是影像；A把孩子初始想法当事实。

questions.prompt: A leaf falls into the puddle.
questions.explanation: A正确：leaf falls into puddle；B否认动作。

questions.prompt: The picture in the puddle stays perfectly still after the leaf falls.
questions.explanation: B正确：小圈出现且cloud picture moves；A与移动相反。

questions.prompt: The writer and Grandpa walk through the puddle.
questions.explanation: B正确：walk around使鞋干；A把绕行改涉水。

materials.title: Garden Wheelbarrow 011
materials.text: Grandma and I work in the garden. We put three heavy pots in a little wheelbarrow. I try to push it, but it does not move. Grandma takes two pots out. Now I can push the barrow slowly. We make three trips instead of one. At the end, all the pots are beside the new fence. Grandma says, "A small load can make a big job easier."

questions.prompt: The writer first tries to push three heavy pots together.
questions.explanation: A正确：先装三个重盆再尝试推；B否认初始负载。

questions.prompt: Grandma takes every pot out of the barrow.
questions.explanation: B正确：取出两盆仍一盆；A把two改all。

questions.prompt: The writer pushes the lighter barrow slowly.
questions.explanation: A正确：减载后can push slowly；B否认变化。

questions.prompt: They move all the pots in one trip.
questions.explanation: B正确：three trips instead of one；A把未实现原设想当结果。

questions.prompt: The pots end up beside the new fence.
questions.explanation: A正确：all pots beside new fence；B否认最终位置。

materials.title: Football Band Captain 011
materials.text: Our football captain wears a yellow band on her arm. On Friday, captain Ella hurts her ankle before the game. She can watch but cannot play. The coach asks Max to lead the team for that game. Ella gives him the band and tells him the team’s plan. Max does not choose new players; the coach has already chosen them. After the game, he returns the band to Ella. Next week, the coach will check whether she can play again.

questions.prompt: Why does Ella not play on Friday?
questions.explanation: A脚踝受伤；B袖带仍在并交出；C无不喜欢信息。

questions.prompt: Who leads the team for that game?
questions.explanation: B教练指定Max临时代领；A邻居、C新裁判未提。

questions.prompt: What does Ella give Max?
questions.explanation: C给黄色袖带并说明计划；A球靴未给；B阵容教练已定非她新名单。

questions.prompt: Who has already chosen the players?
questions.explanation: A教练早已选定；B：Max没重选；C观众无此职责。

questions.prompt: What happens to the band after the game?
questions.explanation: B赛后归还；A永久保留、C扔掉均不符。

units.title: 早餐点单条的两种标记

materials.title: Breakfast Order Slips 011
materials.text: At the school breakfast club, pupils write orders on paper slips. A circle means the meal has been prepared. A tick means it has been collected. Sam sees a circle on his slip and thinks he has already eaten. The helper shows him the two signs. His breakfast is ready on the counter, but he has not collected it. After Sam takes it, the helper adds a tick. The club keeps the slips until the end of the morning so staff can check both stages.

questions.prompt: A circle means a meal is ready.
questions.explanation: A正确：circle prepared表示备好；B否认标记含义。

questions.prompt: A tick means someone has collected the meal.
questions.explanation: A正确：tick collected；B与第二阶段标记相反。

questions.prompt: Sam’s breakfast has already been collected when he first sees the circle.
questions.explanation: B正确：仅备好，尚未领；A混淆两个阶段。

questions.prompt: The helper adds a tick after Sam takes his breakfast.
questions.explanation: A正确：拿餐后加勾；B否认时序。

questions.prompt: The slips are thrown away before breakfast begins.
questions.explanation: B正确：保留至早晨结束供核查；A提前丢弃与原文相反。

units.title: 给美术作品录一段描述

materials.title: Art Audio Description 011
materials.text: Our class made audio descriptions for the art display. We first wrote, "This beautiful picture makes everyone happy." A visitor said that the words told her our opinion but did not help her imagine the picture. We changed the script. It now described three yellow boats below a dark bridge and a small red umbrella on the bank. We kept one short sentence about why the artist chose the scene, using the artist’s own note. Before recording, two pupils read the script while another checked it against the painting. We also printed the same description beside the work so visitors could choose to listen or read.

questions.prompt: The first description mainly gave the class’s opinion.
questions.explanation: A正确：beautiful和everyone happy是观点，访客明确指出；B否认反馈。

questions.prompt: The revised script describes visible objects and colours.
questions.explanation: A正确：黄船、暗桥、红伞为具体物体颜色；B否认修订内容。

questions.prompt: The class invented the artist’s reason without a source.
questions.explanation: B正确：使用artist own note；A把有来源变为编造。

questions.prompt: The script was checked against the painting before recording.
questions.explanation: A正确：另一同学对照画作核对；B否认步骤。

questions.prompt: Visitors could only hear the description and could not read it.
questions.explanation: B正确：同文印在画旁，可听可读；A忽略文字形式。

materials.title: Chess Piece Library 011
materials.text:
Complete the passage with the shared bank. Use each word once. Bank: A. collect B. during C. broken D. beside E. return
At the chess club, spare pieces are kept in a tin ____1____ the cupboard, not inside it. Helpers ____2____ loose pieces from under the tables after each session. A piece with a ____3____ base goes in a separate box because it may not stand up. Members may borrow spare pieces ____4____ a game, but they must ____5____ them before leaving. This keeps every set complete for the next group.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: D beside表柜旁，与not inside对比；A collect收集、E return归还为动词；B during接时段非柜子位置；C broken形容词不能表示此处方位。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: A collect收拢桌下散子；E return后缺目标且此处先收集；B during介词、C broken形容词、D beside介词均不作谓语收集动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C broken底座损坏与站不住相应；A collect、E return动词，B during、D beside介词均不修饰base表示损坏状态。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: B during a game表借用时段；D beside表空间不接比赛表此义；A collect、C broken、E return均不能连接此时间短语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: E return离开前归还合后组完整要求；A collect是收集而非将借物归回；B during、C broken、D beside均不作must后所需归还动作。

materials.title: Trip Note Word Forms 011
materials.text:
Complete each gap with the correct form of the word in brackets. Write one word.
1. These two raincoats are ____1____ (we); our names are inside.
2. Yesterday, Dad ____2____ (buy) our train tickets online.
3. The red suitcase is ____3____ (heavy) than the small blue bag.
4. Please keep both your ____4____ (foot) away from the closing door.
5. Listen! Someone is ____5____ (knock) on our hotel room door.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use WE.
questions.explanation: 接受ours：作系动词后独立物主表语且无后接名词；we主格、us宾格、our须接名词，均不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use BUY.
questions.explanation: 接受bought：Yesterday要求过去时，buy变不规则bought；buy原形、buys单三、buyed拼写错误。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use HEAVY.
questions.explanation: 接受heavier：than提示比较，辅音加y变i加er；heavy原级、heaviest最高级、heavyer拼写错均不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use FOOT.
questions.explanation: 接受feet：both明确双脚，foot变不规则复数；foot单数与both不合，foots非本义标准复数，footed不是所需名词复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: use KNOCK.
questions.explanation: 接受knocking：Listen和is构成正在敲门的进行时；knock原形、knocked过去式、knocks单三均不形成is后所需分词。

units.title: 课后活动问卷的新增选项

materials.title: School Survey Options 011
materials.text:
The student council asked pupils which after-school activity they wanted. The first form offered only football, painting and singing. Nearly half of the pupils chose painting. A council member called it "the favourite activity of the whole school."
Several pupils explained that they had chosen painting only because no other option suited them. Some wanted gardening, while others could not stay after school at all. The council revised the form to include space for another suggestion and an option saying "I cannot attend." It also invited pupils who had missed the first form to reply. In the report, the council kept the first results but labelled them as answers to the original three-option question. The new results were shown separately, with the number of replies stated.

questions.prompt: The first form offered three activities.
questions.explanation: A正确：football painting singing三项；B否认选项数。

questions.prompt: Choosing painting always meant it was a pupil’s first choice among all possible activities.
questions.explanation: B正确：一些人因无合适项勉选；A把受限选择当所有可能活动的首选。

questions.prompt: The revised form allowed pupils to say they could not attend.
questions.explanation: A正确：新增I cannot attend；B否认新渠道。

questions.prompt: Pupils who missed the first form were prevented from replying later.
questions.explanation: B正确：also invited缺席者回复；A把邀请说成禁止。

questions.prompt: The report separated the old and new results and explained the first question’s limits.
questions.explanation: A正确：保留旧标三项题，新数据另列且报回复数；B否认透明说明。
